en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a narrow urban street lined with traditional European three-story buildings. On the left foreground, two people stand on the sidewalk near a decorative street lamp hanging from a building. The street gently curves and recedes into the background, flanked by more closely spaced buildings with gabled roofs. The caption at the bottom reads 'STIKKE HEZELSTRAAT — NIJMEGEN.'
